description: S462 Q10 — a write whose value is provably present (an object literal) narrows the place again from that point: after `clear()` ends the narrowing, `@user = { name: "b" }` re-narrows it. Compiles clean; clicking renders "b".
rationale: §42.3.5 (ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 "a", Q10): "a write whose value is provably present (a struct/object literal, a value of a non-optional type) narrows the place again from that point"
